Caroline Coker
Preserved Primary Document • coker-c1.htm
On 31 May,
1914
she married  Levin Jackson  from Millsboro, Sussex Co., DE.
Caroline and Levin spent their married life in Wilmington, at 508 East 9th Street, where they raised four children:
Levin and Caroline had the following children:

On 31 May, 1914 she married Levin Jackson from Millsboro, Sussex Co., DE. Caroline and Levin spent their married life in Wilmington, at 508 East 9th Street, where they raised four children: Levin and Caroline had the following children: Beatrice Jackson ( 16 Dec. 1915 - ) married William Jackson Francis Lawrence Jackson (1922-1998) married Araminta Morgan Wagner Dupont Jackson (1923- ) married #1 Roma Quinn and #2 Arva Marshall Children of Wagner and Arva Jackson are: Wagner D. Jackson Jr Jeffre Jackson Janine Jackson married James Kearney Martin Naureckas Lenox Lacey Jackson (1927- ) married Alma Wangus They had one child: Lenox Lacey Jackson Jr. Caroline died on 13 July, 1981; Levin died on 18 November, 1981. Both are buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold.
